name: Inventors' Fair
description: A month-long fair across downtown Ghirapur where inventors race, battle and demonstrate their inventions.

timeline.summary: Baan explains that the Inventors' Fair preparations have been disrupted by vandals.
timeline.quote: preparations have been repeatedly disrupted by vandals and malcontents

timeline.summary: Rashmi and Mitul face qualifiers within a week, hoping for the Consulate's support.
timeline.quote: The Inventors' Fair qualifiers were less than a week away.

timeline.summary: The hooded man hides his face and arm in the crowd to complete his mission unnoticed.
timeline.quote: He needed to complete his mission before anyone had a chance to notice him.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret calls the woman Renegade Prime and warns her spectacle will not matter to his Fair, but she vows to stop the Head Judge.
timeline.quote: I've found you at last, Renegade Prime

timeline.summary: The thopters change colors and form the leaking spire symbol over the Fair.
timeline.quote: As the metal of the thopters heated, their colors changed through yellows to greens to rich purples and blues

timeline.summary: Yahenni announces the party of a lifetime after the Inventors' Fair.
timeline.quote: I'm hosting the party of a lifetime here after the conclusion of the Inventors' Fair.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret announces the end of the Inventors' Fair and rises into the airship, retreating.
timeline.quote: And this concludes the Inventors' Fair, everyone.

timeline.summary: Enforcer-Chief Ranaj's soldiers seize inventions across the fairgrounds, provoking panic and anger among the inventors.
timeline.quote: Enforcer-Chief Ranaj's soldiers were seizing inventions in their characteristically clumsy fashion

timeline.summary: The Consulate announces the Inventors' Fair, to be held for a month across downtown Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: For a full month, the fairgrounds will span the whole of downtown Ghirapur, the largest city on Kaladesh.

relations.note: He calls it his Fair and is addressed as Head Judge.
relations.quote: Do you think your little spectacle is going to matter to my Fair?

pages_say.description: A Kaladeshi festival in Ghirapur with expositions of artifice and grants, disrupted by vandals.
The festival of invention in Ghirapur where inventors compete for patrons and the Consulate's support.
The Kaladeshi festival that a disruption threatens and which Tezzeret calls his own.
The festival where the renegades stage their thopter display.
The festival before which Yahenni throws a party and after which he plans a final one.
The Kaladeshi festival ended by Tezzeret's confiscation of its inventions.
The festival being dismantled by the Consulate's confiscation.
A month-long fair across downtown Ghirapur where inventors race, battle and demonstrate their inventions.
The fair that Rashmi won with her transporter.
The fair after which the Consulate's crackdown began.
